title: Pending | EU 261 | 72 Hours
description:
EU-originating flight occurred less than 72 hours ago. DDS hasn't processed the data yet because the standard processing window is 72 hours. Case is created in Pending state. Mirrors APPR pending test (TC_077) but for EU 261 regime. Validates that the 72-hour processing window applies equally to EU 261 claims.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger, 1 leg AC operated LHR?YYZ. Itinerary: Flight operated yesterday (within 72hr window). Scheduled arrival 16:00, Actual arrival 20:00 (4hr delay). Disruption code: Not yet available in DDS (within 72hr processing window). Filing time: 30 hours after flight. DDS status: Data processing not yet complete. Route context: LHR = UK origin ? EU 261 applies.
